children: Leslie B. Daniels, a Director, reported sales of Anterix common stock on September 3–4, 2026. The transactions comprised three direct sales: 6,000 shares at a weighted average price of $87.15, 2,900 shares at a weighted average price of $87.3103, and 1,200 shares at $86.50. The total proceeds from the sales were $879,899. Following the reported transactions, Daniels directly owned 45,977 shares and indirectly owned 7,000 shares via IRA and 401(k).
